title: Ungashintsha Kanjani Imininingwane Yebhange ye-SASSA — Guqula I-Akhawunti Ngokukhokhelwa Kwe-Grant
description: Umhlahlandlela ngezinyathelo zokuguqula i-akhawunti yebhange yezinkokhelo ze-grant ye-SASSA: ku-inthanethi nge-SRD portal noma ubhekisise esikhungweni se-SASSA. Izidingo, isikhathi sokucubungula, nezexwayiso ezibalulekile.

seo.metaDescription: Vuselela imininingwane yakho yebhange ye-SASSA ngo-2026 ku-inthanethi nge-SRD portal noma esikhungweni. Landela umhlahlandlela wethu ngezinyathelo ukuze ushintshe ama-akhawunti.

contentBlocks.title: Ungashintsha Kanjani Imininingwane Yebhange ye-SASSA — Guqula I-Akhawunti Ngokukhokhelwa Kwe-Grant
contentBlocks.description: Udinga ukushintsha i-akhawunti yebhange lapho i-grant yakho ye-SASSA iyistholwa khona? Funda ukuthi ungavuselela kanjani imininingwane yakho ku-inthanethi nge-SRD portal noma ubhekisise esikhungweni se-SASSA, nokuthi ulindele ini ngesikhathi sokuqinisekiswa kwebhange.

contentBlocks.text: Uma udinga ukushintsha i-akhawunti yebhange lapho i-grant yakho ye-SASSA ikhokhelwa khona, ungakwenza ku-inthanethi nge-SRD portal noma ubhekisise esikhungweni se-SASSA. I-akhawunti entsha kufanele ibhaliswe egameni lakho.

Uma ushintshe amabhange, uvale i-akhawunti endala, noma wenze iphutha lokubhala sikhathi esidlule, usesendaweni efanele. Lokhu kunye kwemisebenzi emincane yokuphatha izikhathi lapho umuzwa uyifa, kodwa ngempela ikubalulekile — imininingwane yebhange engalungile iyizona ezinombono eyodwa yezinkokhelo ze-grant zithela ekuyiphikisweni.

contentBlocks.title: I-akhawunti KUFANELE ibe yeyakho
contentBlocks.text: I-SASSA ikhokha kuphela ku-akhawunti egameni lomfaki isicelo. Awunakusebenzisa i-akhawunti yesihlobo noma yomngani — ngisho nangemvume yabo. Uma ungenayo i-akhawunti yakho, sebenzisa i-Cash Send noma ikhadi le-SASSA esikhundleni sokuthi ulegise izinkokhelo ezinqunywayo.

steps.title: Ngena ku-SRD portal
steps.description: Yiya ku-srd.sassa.gov.za. Faka inombolo yakho ye-ID nenombolo yocingo. Qinisekisa nge-OTP ethunyelwe kucingo.

steps.title: Yiya ku-'Vuselela Imininingwane Yebhange'
steps.description: Thola isigaba semininingwane yebhange kudashboard yakho.

steps.title: Faka imininingwane yakho entsha yebhange
steps.description: Nika igama lebhange lakho entsha, inombolo ye-akhawunti, ikhodi yegatsha, nohlobo lwe-akhawunti (Ukulondolozwa, I-Cheque, noma Ukudluliswa).

steps.title: Qinisekisa imininingwane
steps.description: Bheka izinombolo zonke ze-akhawunti nekhodi yegatsha. Inombolo eyodwa engalungile ibambezela izinkokhelo zakho.

steps.title: Thumela bese ulindela ukuqinisekiswa
steps.description: I-SASSA izoqinisekisa i-akhawunti entsha nebhangeni lakho. Lokhu kuthatha izinsuku ezi-5 kuya kwezi-10 zokusebenza.

contentBlocks.text: Uma ungakwazi ukufinyelela ku-portal ku-inthanethi, vakashela isikhungo se-SASSA esisedu kunakho konke ne-ID yakho nesishozo sebhange noma incwadi yebhange eqinisekisa i-akhawunti entsha. Gcwalisa iForm Yomvume Ye-SASSA Yokukhokhelwa Ebhange bese umhloli we-SASSA ucubungula ushintsho.

contentBlocks.title: Imitherho Ebalulekile
contentBlocks.text: I-akhawunti yebhange kufanele ibe egameni lakho. I-SASSA ngeke ikhokhe izingodo kuma-akhawunti abantu besithathu. Ukuqinisekiswa kwebhange kuthatha izinsuku ezi-5-10 zokusebenza. Ungavali i-akhawunti yakho endala kuze kube isikhokhelo sokuqala sifika ku-akhawunti entsha.

faqs.question: Kuthatha isikhathi esingakanani ukuvuselelwa kwemininingwane yebhange?
faqs.answer: Ukuqinisekiswa kwebhange kuthatha izinsuku ezi-5 kuya kwezi-10 zokusebenza. Uma sekuqinisekisiwe, i-akhawunti entsha isetshenziselwa ukukhokhelwa kwenyanga elandelayo.

faqs.question: Ngiyakwazi ukuvuselela imininingwane yami yebhange uma ngilahlekelwe ukufinyelela enombolweni yami yocingo?
faqs.answer: Cha. Kufanele uvakashele isikhungo se-SASSA ne-ID yakho ukuze uvuselele inombolo yocingo kuqala, bese usebenzisa i-portal ku-inthanethi.

faqs.question: Ukushintsha imininingwane yami yebhange kuzothinta yini isikhokhelwa senyanga yamanje?
faqs.answer: Uma ushintsha imininingwane yakho ngemva kwama-20th enyanga, ushintsho luzosebenza kusukela enyangeni elandelayo. Ungashintshi imininingwane ngesikhathi isikhokhelwa sicubungula.
